artBrief: **Dark fantasy.** A small keeper shelters a bright brazier beneath a broken stone canopy while rain falls outside. Warmth and resilience lead the scene.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Dark fantasy. A small keeper shelters a bright brazier beneath a broken stone canopy while rain falls outside. Warmth and resilience lead the scene. A humble keeper shielding a bright amber brazier under broken slate canopy. Rain stays in the cool blue background; large warm flame as focal shape, resilient and cozy, not threatening.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
